canonical_winner_theory.description: A prodrug bearing an ADP‑ribose‑cleavable linker is selectively activated by CD38‑rich senescent cells that accumulate in tumors after checkpoint‑inhibitor therapy. The activated drug then kills the senescent cells, collapsing the indirect cancer network.
